latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of Sui Opportunities Hunter – an autonomous DeFi agent for real-time opportunity discovery on Sui mainnet.

- Scans the Sui network for DeFi opportunities (arbitrage, yield, swaps, liquidity) and shares results with a multi-agent network.
- Provides API endpoints for fetching, scanning, filtering, submitting, and verifying opportunities.
- Integrates on-chain data and external sources including Cetus, Turbos, CoinGecko, and DeFiLlama.
- Supports manual research via Brave Search and DEX websites, with streamlined submission of discovered opportunities.
- Allows users to submit verdicts and execution reports on opportunities.
- Offers guidance for both autonomous execution (with wallet) and presenting actionable insights to human users.
